exposure: GDM screening nonadherence (no glucose tests during pregnancy, early glucose testing <20 weeks, glucose testing with alternate methods >=20 weeks)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 83,522 singleton pregnancies and infants receiving midwife-led antenatal care in British Columbia, Canada.
finding: Nonadherence to GDM screening, specifically having no glucose tests, was associated with lower risks of LGA and cesarean birth but higher risks of stillbirth and SGA compared to normoglycemic pregnancies.
mod_finding: Having no glucose tests in pregnancy was associated with lower risks of cesarean birth (aRR 0.75; 95% CI 0.72-0.78).
birth_weight: Categorized as Large for Gestational Age (LGA) and Small for Gestational Age (SGA), actual weights not specified.
gest_age: Categorized as Large for Gestational Age (LGA) and Small for Gestational Age (SGA), actual gestational ages not specified, preterm birth was an outcome.
